Free entry; PLN 135,000 prize pool, results on 9 Dec 2026.

Nizom 2026-yil 6-oktabrda özgartirilgan - loyihalaşdan oldin eng so'nggi tahririni öqing.

items.title_en: Hoehyeon-dong Public Parking & Senior/Child Welfare Facility Complex — Proposal Design Competition
items.organizer_uz: Seul şahri Jung-gu tumani (taxminiy — rasmiy e'lon topilmadi)
items.organizer_en: Jung-gu District, Seoul (inferred from the site — official notice not found)
items.eligibility_uz: Amalda faqat Koreyada röyxatdan ötgan arxitektura byurolari uçun. Tanlov içki (xalqaro emas) taklifli tanlov (제안공모). Koreya Arxitektorlar töğrisidagi qonunining (건축사법) 23-moddasi 5-bandiga köra, çet el litsenziyasiga ega arxitektor Koreyada faqat Koreyada oçilgan byuro (건축사사무소) bilan birgalikda işlay oladi. Içki tanlovlarda bunday qöşma iştirok odatda közda tutilmaydi. Şu tanlovning aniq iştirok şartlari (지침서) öqilmadi.
items.eligibility_en: Effectively Korean-registered architecture offices only. It is a domestic (non-international) proposal competition (제안공모). Under Korea's Certified Architects Act (건축사법) Art. 23(5), a foreign-licensed architect may practise in Korea only jointly with a Korean registered office (건축사사무소개설자), and domestic competitions normally don't provide for that. The competition-specific eligibility clause (in the 설계지침서) could not be read.
items.fee_uz: Taxminiy loyihalaş haqi 320 mln KRW (~230 ming USD); taxminiy quriliş qiymati 5,62 mlrd KRW (~4,0 mln USD). Mukofot jamğarmasi haqida ma'lumot topilmadi.
items.fee_en: Estimated design fee KRW 320 million (~USD 230k); estimated construction cost KRW 5.62 billion (~USD 4.0M). Prize/compensation money: not found.

items.eligibility_uz: Xalqaro tanlov (KONEPS'da '국제입찰: ha' deb belgilangan). items.eligibility_en: International competition (KONEPS flag 국제입찰 = yes). Under 건축사법 Art. 23(5), a foreign-licensed architect may take design commissions in Korea only jointly with a Korean registered office, and must notify the Ministry (MOLIT). In practice foreign entrants submit jointly with a Korean firm. The competition's own eligibility clause was not read.
